title: Self-Deadlock on Non-Recursive Mutex
pattern: A single thread attempts to re-acquire a non-recursive mutex that it currently holds.
why_bad: The thread blocks waiting for itself to release the lock, creating an immediate, unconditional single-thread deadlock.
detection: A path in the control-flow graph (CFG) where a lock guard's lifetime overlaps with another acquisition of the same lock object within the same thread.
counterexample: Using recursive locks (`ReentrantMutex`), where re-entry increments an internal reference counter rather than blocking.
